    Dimension vectors #

    For a complete family of orthogonal idempotents e : ι → A, a finite-dimensional module is the direct sum of the subspaces e_x M (piEquiv), so its dimension is the sum of the entries of its dimension vector dimv M x = dim e_x M (finrank_eq_sum_dimv). Isomorphic modules have equal dimension vectors (dimv_congr), and dimension vectors add on direct sums (dimv_prod).
